newsitem.title: USA: Steel Dynamics files to register offering.
newsitem.headline: Steel Dynamics files to register offering.

text.p: Steel Dynamics Inc filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to 8.4 million common shares of which the company will sell 1,255,971 shares and a group of shareholders will sell 7,144,029 shares.

Those selling shares in the offering include: General Electric Capital Corp.., which is selling 1,440,029 shares; Preussag Stahl AG, which is selling 550,000 shares; and J.H. Whitney & Co, which is selling 1,450,000

Underwriters for the offering, Morgan Stanley Dean Ditter, PaineWebber Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, McDonald & Co Securities Inc and Salomon Brothers Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 1,260,000 shares.
Of the 8.4 million shares to be offered, 6.72 million will be sold in the United States and the remaining 1.68 million shares will be offered overseas.
After the offering, the company will have 49,122,294 shares outstading.
Steel Dynamcis said it will use the proceeds from the shares it sells to purchase and install a seventh stand for its hot-rolling mill and for other general corporate needs.
